hero.title: Investment criteria
hero.subtitle: Is your business the right fit? Criteria for strategic growth

intro: We invest in majority and substantial minority equity recapitalizations in leading middle-market technology and innovation-enabled businesses.

criteria.note: Live wording from /investment-criteria/. Proposed update (EBITDA $3M–$6M, revenue $10M–$40M, 4–12 years) is not yet approved for publication.

items.title: $2M+ in EBITDA and $8M+ in Revenue
items.body: Cash-flow-positive companies across the US and Canada.

items.title: Benefits from Utilizing Technology
items.body: Black Lake looks to leverage technology and innovation to increase revenue growth and profitability.

items.title: Strong Management Teams
items.body: Black Lake partners with executives who lead their respective industries and have a history of success.

items.title: Market-Leading Positions
items.body: Companies that create defensible, competitive positions naturally set themselves up to provide recurring revenue and pricing power.

items.title: Positive Industry Trends
items.body: Black Lake wants to be in it for the long term. We use market research and our extensive executive network to look for positive trends.

items.title: Shared Values
items.body: We seek business owners and managers who share our values of collaboration, commitment, and compassion.
